high.title: Full Stack Engineer
high.description:
About Enterprise Bot
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.
We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.
Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.
We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.
Your first months at Enterprise Bot
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys working across both frontend and backend and wants to build products at the intersection of software engineering and AI.
You’ll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.
This isn't a role where you'll just pick up tickets and write code.
We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end — understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.
What You'll Do
Full Stack Development

- 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.
- 
Build responsive, intuitive, and high-performance user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js.
- 
Work across the complete product lifecycle — from technical design to development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
- 
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
- 
Build reusable components and maintain clean, scalable code.


Backend & APIs

- 
Design and develop secure and reusable RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Build backend services using Node.js, Express.js, Koa, or similar frameworks.
- 
Design efficient database schemas and optimise queries.
- 
Work with MongoDB and SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Implement authentication and authorisation using technologies such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Build integrations with internal and external systems.
- 
Troubleshoot production issues and improve system performance and reliability.


Frontend

- 
Build modern web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Translate product and UI designs into high-quality, production-ready interfaces.
- 
Create reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture.
- 
Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant.
- 
Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.


AI & Agentic Systems
You’ll be working in an AI-first engineering environment.

- 
Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications.
- 
Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation.
- 
Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration.
- 
Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations.
- 
Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences.
- 
Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools.


You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI.
Quality, Performance & Reliability

- 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
- 
Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai.
- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
- 
Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability.
- 
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
- 
Document technical solutions, APIs, and architecture where required.


Collaboration

- 
Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers.
- 
Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions.
- 
Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions.
- 
Take ownership of features and deliver them from concept → production.
- 
Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture.


What we are looking for

- 
2–4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
- 
Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
- 
Strong backend development experience with Node.js.
- 
Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development.
- 
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture.
- 
Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control.
- 
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
- 
Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently.
- 
Good understanding of responsive web development.
- 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- 
Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.


Good to Have

- 
Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
- 
Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
- 
Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures.
- 
Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
- 
Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
- 
Experience with microservices architecture.
- 
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- 
Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
- 
Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company.
- 
Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows.


What We Value
At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles.
We're looking for someone who:

- 
Doesn't wait for instructions for every step.
- 
Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it.
- 
Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment.
- 
Cares about the quality of what they build.
- 
Is curious about AI and new technologies.
- 
Enjoys learning and experimenting.
- 
Can balance speed with good engineering practices.
- 
Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack.


Benefits

- 
Build products at the forefront of GenAI and Conversational AI.
- 
Work on real-world AI products used by international enterprises.
- 
Get exposure to LLMs, AI agents, automation, voice, and real-time systems.
- 
Work with a global engineering and product team.
- 
High ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact.
- 
Flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative culture.
- 
Opportunity to learn and work with rapidly evolving AI technologies.
- 
Competitive compensation and strong opportunities for growth.


Join our team
If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

General Summary

Job Description

Qualcomm's CAD Infrastructure team develops and operates mission-critical engineering platforms used by thousands of engineers across CPU, DSP, AI, SoC, Physical Design, Verification, and Software organizations. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and scale modern web applications, automation platforms, data services, and AI-enabled solutions that improve engineering productivity across the company.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack—from intuitive front-end user experiences to highly scalable backend services, cloud-native infrastructure, data platforms, and AI-driven workflows.

You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, technical program managers, DevOps engineers, and infrastructure architects to deliver tools that are used daily by Qualcomm's engineering community.

Minimum Qualifications



-  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.


OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

- Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade full stack applications used across engineering organizations.
- Build modern web UIs using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks.
- Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Express, or similar technologies.
- Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
- Build and optimize large-scale data platforms leveraging SQL and NoSQL databases.
- Develop automation workflows for engineering productivity, infrastructure management, analytics, and reporting.
- Partner with infrastructure teams to deploy and operate applications in Kubernetes and containerized environments.
- Build dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools.
- Integrate AI/ML and LLM technologies into internal engineering workflows where applicable.
- Drive software architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and best practices.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering excellence across the team.
- Troubleshoot performance, scalability, reliability, and security issues in production environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business and engineering requirements into technical solutions.


Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
- 8+ years of professional software development experience.
- Strong experience building and deploying full stack web applications.
- Expert-level programming skills in Python.
- Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.
- Experience developing modern front-end applications using React.
- Experience building REST APIs and microservices.

- Experience working in Linux environments.
- Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, or cloud-native platforms.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

stretch.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
stretch.description:
About BrightCHAMPS


BrightChamps is a fast-growing EdTech company building learning experiences that help children develop real-world skills and confidence. We blend pedagogy, technology, and data to create scalable learning programs.


About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on full-stack engineer who has built and operated real-time communication systems at scale. You'll work on WebRTC, video conferencing, and streaming infrastructure, and you'll own the health of those systems end to end. Building the system is only half the job. We expect you to know whether it is actually working, using telemetry, metrics, traces, browser waterfalls, WebRTC statistics, and network behavior. "The deployment succeeded" isn't proof that the system is fine. The data is. You will also work on agentic and AI-powered platforms, using AI as a force multiplier across engineering, debugging, and product problem-solving.


What We're Looking For


Required

- Strong experience building full-stack applications. Minimum 4 years
- Strong experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and MySQL.
- Hands-on experience building or operating WebRTC/video conferencing systems, including
- WebRTC providers or platforms at meaningful scale.
- Strong understanding of WebRTC and real-time media: simulcast, adaptive bitrate, codecs,
- RTP/RTCP, ICE, STUN/TURN, and related concepts.
- Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
- Experience with production telemetry, monitoring, and observability.
- Ability to analyze browser waterfalls and network behavior.
- Experience with distributed systems and production infrastructure.
- Strong understanding of AI development tools and workflows.


Strong Plus



- Experience building agentic platforms or AI-powered products.
- Experience with large-scale conferencing platforms or thousands of concurrent real-time
- connections.
- Experience with Amazon IVS, LiveKit, Agora, Twilio, Daily, Vonage, or similar platforms.
- Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar observability tooling.
- Experience building real-time dashboards and monitoring systems.
- Experience with media quality analytics and WebRTC QoS.
- Experience with Kubernetes and AWS.


What You'll Do
1. Work on agentic and AI platforms



- Build applications where AI agents interact with users, tools, APIs, and business systems.
- Understand agent workflows, tool calling, state management, and orchestration.
- Build reliable systems around LLMs and agents, with attention to latency, reliability,
- observability, and cost.
- Evaluate and monitor AI-powered workflows.
- Use AI aggressively as a development multiplier. You should ask "Can AI do this for me?" before
- spending hours on repetitive work by hand.


2. Full-stack engineering



- Frontend: Build with React.js and Next.js, with a solid grasp of browser performance, state
- management, API integration, and modern web architecture. Debug issues at the frontend,
- browser, and network levels.
- Backend: Design and build APIs and backend services in Node.js. Work with asynchronous and
- distributed systems, MySQL and database design, caching, queues, and event-driven
- architecture.
- Infrastructure: Understand cloud infrastructure, containers, deployment, scaling, and
- observability, and debug across application, infrastructure, and network layers.

The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence.


We are excited to announce an opening for Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC) at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 
Position Title: Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC) 
Roles & responsibilities: 

- Build and test parts of agents for the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) pod, guided by senior engineers. 
- Contribute to agents for stages of the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
- Implement tool/function calling and use MCP servers, including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP, in the agents you work on. 
- Implement RAG pipelines and basic memory and state handling for your agents. 
- Write evals for the parts you build: a small golden dataset, simple LLM-as-judge checks and regression tests. Run them before each change. 
- Add tracing and logging to your agents, and use traces to debug failures. 
- Follow the pod's guardrails, including prompt-injection defenses and human-in-the-loop approval points. 
- Write production code every week. Use agentic coding tools daily (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and check every change they produce before you commit it. 
- Take part in code and agent reviews, and learn from the feedback. 
- Report how your agents perform against the baseline the pod sets, and learn to watch token cost. 
- Work with senior engineers and partner teams to meet security and compliance standards. 


Experience Required: 

- AI experience is a MUST. You have built an LLM agent or RAG application end to end, with at least one eval. An AI internship, coursework or a personal project counts. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
- 1-3 years of software engineering experience. Recent graduates with a strong AI project or internship are welcome to apply. There is no CGPA cutoff. 
- Programming fundamentals in Python, Java or TypeScript: you write clean, tested code. 
- Prompt engineering basics, and tool/function calling and MCP basics. Frameworks are examples only (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
- Understanding of RAG and of how an agent keeps memory and state. 
- Understanding of how to evaluate an LLM application with a golden dataset, and why tracing matters. 
- Responsible use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor): you review and understand code before you accept it, and you know when not to trust the output. 
- A plus: cloud exposure on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
- Willingness to learn from code reviews and from senior engineers. 


Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
- Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason 
- Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
- Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions 
- Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
- Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally 
- Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work 
- Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens 
- Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
- Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals.
